images.title: A pinwheel turned a quarter at a time
images.purpose: Show the worked example: a pinwheel with a dot on its top blade, shown at the start and after a 1/4 turn, a 1/2 turn and a 3/4 turn, with the dot on the right, bottom and left blade.
images.composition: Four pinwheels in one row, each with a caption under it and a curved arrow between neighbours.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Four pinwheels in one row, centred at x 214, 571, 928 and 1285, all at y 380. Each is a pinwheel made of exactly 4 identical teal #0072B2 triangular blades with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines, each blade a triangle whose point is at the centre pin and whose flat side faces outward, one blade pointing up, one right, one down and one left, together about 230 px across, with a small dark circle (20 px) for the pin at the centre. On exactly one blade of each pinwheel an amber #E69F00 dot (36 px across, thin dark outline) sits near the outer edge: on the TOP blade of the first pinwheel, on the RIGHT blade of the second, on the BOTTOM blade of the third and on the LEFT blade of the fourth. The four pinwheels are otherwise identical. Between neighbouring pinwheels, centred at x 392, 749 and 1106 and y 380, one short curved arrow in reddish purple #CC79A7 bending to the right, 90 px wide, 3 arrows in all. Under the pinwheels, centred on each at y 600, a caption in dark #1F2937 sans-serif (40 px): Start, 1/4 turn, 1/2 turn, 3/4 turn. In all there are exactly 4 pinwheels, 4 dots, 3 arrows and 4 captions. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a dot on more than one blade of the same pinwheel
images.takeaway: The dot shows how far a shape has turned: a 1/4 turn moves it one blade round.
images.description: Four copies of a four-blade pinwheel with a dot on the top, right, bottom and left blade, labelled Start, 1/4 turn, 1/2 turn and 3/4 turn.
images.context: Concept image for the first teaching concept, Quarter, Half and Three-Quarter Turns. It uses the plan's own pinwheel (a practice value), not the book's firki.
images.teaching_notes: Follow the dot with a finger from picture to picture. The pinwheel itself looks the same each time; only the dot tells how far it turned.

image_decisions.why: The four pinwheels with the dot on a different blade make the worked example visible: a quarter turn moves the dot one blade round.
